steps.player: Err what am I doing again?

steps.speaker: Mizaru
steps.text: Get a red banana, some tchiki monkey nuts, and the snake corpse.  Prepare the ingredients and stuff them into the snake. Simple.  Even Kikazaru could do it.

steps.player: Thanks.

options.text: So how do I cook it again?

steps.player: How do I cook this thing, it's huge! It's not going to fit in an oven or on a spit?

steps.speaker: Mizaru
steps.text: A very good question. Anyone know?

steps.speaker: Iwazaru
steps.text: (Iwazaru nods) He looks at Kikazaru to translate for him.

steps.speaker: Kikazaru
steps.text: Zzzzzzzzzzzzzzz

steps.speaker: Iwazaru
steps.text: (Iwazaru prods Kikazaru)

steps.speaker: Kikazaru
steps.text: Zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz

steps.speaker: Iwazaru
steps.text: (Iwazaru sighs, and then points to the floor directly beneath him, then acts like a zombie.

steps.speaker: Iwazaru
steps.text: He then points at you and falls over and plays dead, gets up and then shrugs.)

steps.player: Hmmm, somewhere underneath here, with zombies?

steps.speaker: Iwazaru
steps.text: (Iwazaru nods)

steps.speaker: Iwazaru
steps.text: (He then wipes his forehead as if it were hot and points at the sacrificial pyre in the east of the temple.)

steps.player: Somewhere hot, nearby? What's this business about me dying though - that's not so cool.

steps.speaker: Iwazaru
steps.text: (Iwazaru shrugs)

steps.player: Well, I suppose I'd better have a look.

options.text: So how do I cook it again?

You try to stuff the snake into the oven but it just won't fit!

ape-atoll-cooking-the-snake-cooking-the-.text: You cook the stuffed snake to perfection.

ape-atoll-cooking-the-snake-eating-stuff.prompt: Are you sure you want to eat the cooked snake?

steps.text: You eat the stuffed snake - it's quite a meal! It tastes like chicken.

finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-aft.speaker: Mizaru
finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-aft.text: You still here? You haven't lost the royal dish have you?

finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-aft.speaker: Mizaru
finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-aft.text: You'd better make another one then... You know what to do.

finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-wit.player: Yup, it's all cooked and ready to go, or at least I think it is.

finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-wit.speaker: Mizaru
finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-wit.text: Maybe the King wouldn't notice if we had a little bit?

finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-wit.speaker: Iwazaru
finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-wit.text: Iwazaru slaps both of the other monkeys on the back of the head!

finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-wit.player: Yeah, listen to Iwazaru - stay away from my stuffed snake! I'm not making another one.  There was more than enough monkey business involved in making this one.

finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-wit.speaker: Mizaru
finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-wit.text: Take that thing away from us.  It will only fill us with unfulfilled longing...

finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-wit.player: Thanks for your help guys! I've had more fun than a barrel of monkeys doing this.
Though I wish I'd realised earlier on that Iwazaru was the monkey with brains...

finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-wit.speaker: Iwazaru
finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-wit.text: (Iwazaru mimes a crown on his head.)

finishing-up-talking-to-wise-monkeys-wit.player: Heh, time to serve this to the king...

finishing-up-trying-to-feed-king-awowoge.text: Maybe you should wear your amulet of Monkeyspeak before talking to the Monkey King...

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.speaker: King Awowogei
finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.text: Err Where am I? Ooh! Roasted Stuffed Snake, lovely.

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.speaker: King Awowogei
finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.text: Mmmm, I'm sure I can detect the delicate aroma of Tchiki Monkey nuts, and the sweet perfume of Red Bananas, all slowly caramelised on hot rocks.
King Awowogei tucks into his roasted snake.

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.player: I'm just a wandering chef, travelling from town to town saving peoples lives.

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.speaker: King Awowogei
finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.text: gorge* You're a bit odd, aren't you?

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.player: Yet again, my heroic work goes unappreciated, I suppose that is the fate of a true hero.
So ... I've heard that this dish makes you more cooperative.

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.speaker: King Awowogei
finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.text: stuff* That's a lie, no definitely not. Well maybe.

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.player: Well, getting to Ape Atoll is quite a pain.  Do you have a way of making it easier to get there?

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.speaker: King Awowogei
finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.text: N,   Nnnnn..... nghghghnmnmn ... Yes there is a spell.

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.player: Will you let me know how to cast it?

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.speaker: King Awowogei
finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.text: Absolutely No... Nerrrrnnnn...Oh, go on then.

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.player: So, what do I need to know?

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.speaker: King Awowogei
finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.text: Well, it will take a while to explain...

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.player: Ah I see, so the banana actually has the crucial effect on the teleportation matrix.
I'm sorry I forced you to tell me the spell.

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.speaker: King Awowogei
finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.text: Oh that's alright - it could have been worse - you could have asked me to marry you.

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.player: Yes - that would have been a lot worse.

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.speaker: King Awowogei
finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.text: Anyway, it seems you have done me a favour. Though I'm a bit confused about what went on here.

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.player: You're confused? Get a ticket and join the queue, Your Monkeyness.

finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.speaker: Aris
finishing-up-feeding-king-awowogei.text: Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have [X] council member[s] left to protect!

finishing-up-trying-to-get-more-red-bana.text: You have already made the King's meal, you dont need any more of these.

finishing-up-talking-to-the-wise-old-mon.speaker: Mizaru
finishing-up-talking-to-the-wise-old-mon.text: Born from an egg on a mountain top,

finishing-up-talking-to-the-wise-old-mon.speaker: Mizaru
finishing-up-talking-to-the-wise-old-mon.text: The punkiest Monkey that ever popped,

finishing-up-talking-to-the-wise-old-mon.speaker: Mizaru
finishing-up-talking-to-the-wise-old-mon.text: All monkey stories are fun. Maybe I'll tell it to you some time...
